The bike lane looked quieter than usual that evening. Little by little, things began to change. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, apply the ointment twice a day.

Ben will take part in a baseball match in March. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Ben has practiced baseball for three years and won a prize last term. She goes for a checkup every year.

Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Ben thanked Anna for the honest advice. On Wednesday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Best of all, a care assistant helps with washing.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. People around Ben often share different ideas about the bike lane. Also, talk helps mental health too.
At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. Anna and Ben are preparing a report about the bike lane. The experience taught Ben more than any book could.
